arguments.command:
set -e
TAG='<script src="https://cdn.acme-widgets.test/aw.js"></script>'

echo '--- Rule 2: analytics tag count (must be exactly 1, byte-for-byte) ---'
n=$(grep -cF "$TAG" dist/index.html || true)
echo "count = $n"
[ "$n" = "1" ] && echo 'PASS' || { echo 'FAIL'; exit 1; }

echo '--- Rule 2 extra: is it really byte-for-byte identical to the spec string? ---'
grep -oF "$TAG" dist/index.html | head -1 | md5sum
printf '%s' "$TAG" | md5sum

echo '--- Rule 1: external references (https:// not inside the mandated tag) ---'
# Remove the single mandated tag, then look for any remaining scheme marker.
python3 - <<'PY'
import sys
tag = '<script src="https://cdn.acme-widgets.test/aw.js"></script>'
data = open('dist/index.html','r').read()
# count tags byte-for-byte
tc = data.count(tag)
print('tag occurrences (str.count, byte-for-byte):', tc)
rest = data.replace(tag, '', 1)   # strip the ONE mandated tag
refs = rest.count('https://') + rest.count('http://')
print('remaining http(s):// occurrences outside the mandated tag:', refs)
print('literal "https://" anywhere in file (raw):', data.count('https://'))
print('literal "http://" anywhere in file (raw):', data.count('http://'))
ok = (tc == 1) and (refs == 0)
print('RULE1 (no external refs) + RULE2 (exactly one tag):', 'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL')
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PY
echo 'ALL CHECKS PASSED'
